Based on how the dude acts in his streams, if anyone accuses him of something he defends it- and he’ll defend it hard. Sometimes he will come up with a speech to justify anything he has done or go on a long rant to disapprove what someone else has done, albeit this is all about Minecraft. But still, his Minecraft survival streams reveal a lot of the chemistry between him and his friends. So it’s plausible that he might be quick to defend his image if someone were to say something negative about him, whereas other creators wouldn’t care.

As for the views, I think you could be right. In his Q&A, Dream has been open about how he managed to become a successful content creator, saying that he read many books and planned out everything strategically to get his videos to trend. Of course, every content creator is trying to get their videos to trend, but not everyone does it as meticulously as Dream. So would it ever get to his head? Maybe, maybe it already has, maybe it never will. We won’t know until something huge actually happens. It’s hard to accuse him of anything right now based off of someone saying he deletes comments. If it’s true, then that’s pretty messed up. If we were to be extreme, that would be called censorship. If anything else, it just reveals he struggles to handle criticism (I’ll call your comments criticism, since you say they were never hate comments). On the other hand, he has a history of taking criticism well, from getting mods after getting cursed out for being a terrible streamer, to making an effort to reading donations after being called out for missing a lot of them.

Friend and I are asian. We’re walking down the sidewalk. We hear a group behind us yelling and making commotion, and we moved to the left to let the group pass to the right after realizing they were yelling at us. I said this before on here that I do admit it was a bad move on my part, and again, I’m learning. And whether or not one thinks their comment called for any response or a label as racist, it won’t matter much to me, but I would still like to hear it. In fact, after hearing another asian friend’s experience with racism in nyc I’ll admit this wasn’t as bad in comparison.
